conclusion: One return observation is recorded for each joint under the established off-power movement procedure. Each displayed return is near its starting value; maximum absolute displayed difference is 0.76 deg. This completes collection of this six-joint test round, not overall CAL-01 qualification.
limitations: Manual return alignment, load/support differences, and encoder error are not separated.
A1/A4 powered readings extend beyond -180/+180 deg; the tests do not establish every power-up branch or retained multi-turn identity.
Normal CAN feedback versus documented p_m/xout, where supported, remains part of CAL-01.
